description: A smooth fragment of glass lies among the sand.
story: Sand can change form under extraordinary heat. What else might this place become?

description: Parallel ridges stretch across the dune surface.
story: The wind has been writing here all night. By morning, its words will change.

description: Tiny paired tracks cross an otherwise untouched slope.
story: Something small has crossed this enormous place without asking to be seen.

description: A seed rests just beneath the dry surface.
story: It has not disappeared. It is waiting for the right moment.

description: One side of a small stone is worn smooth by blowing sand.
story: Change can happen so slowly that no one notices until a new shape remains.

description: Shimmering air makes the far-off ground resemble water.
story: From a distance, the desert offers a different version of itself.

description: A winding channel cuts through dry earth.
story: This place remembers the shape of water, even when none is visible.

description: A web of cracks covers the dried riverbed.
story: The ground has opened into patterns left by water and sun.

description: A rounded pebble sits among rough stones.
story: Water once carried this stone farther than it could ever travel alone.

description: Twigs and leaves are caught high in a narrow bend.
story: The quiet channel can change suddenly. Its edges hold evidence of a passing flood.

description: A pale outline remains where a shallow pool once dried.
story: The water left, but not without a mark.

description: Different footprints overlap in the sand near the channel.
story: Even an empty riverbed can be a meeting place.

description: A pale desert flower opens after sunset.
story: Not everything reveals itself in daylight.

description: A moth hovers near a flower in the cool evening air.
story: In the dark, a quiet exchange takes place between flower and visitor.

description: A stone that held the daytime heat now feels cool.
story: The desert is not one temperature, one mood, or one moment.

description: A tall rock casts a long shadow under a bright moon.
story: A familiar landmark becomes unfamiliar when the light changes.

description: A small opening leads beneath the sand.
story: Aboveground is only part of the desert. Another world begins below.

description: Stars crowd the sky above the hollow.
story: Without the daylight, the desert reveals a different kind of distance.

description: A narrow stone opening has been shaped by erosion.
story: The stone did not choose this shape, but it holds the sky within it.

description: A voice returns in fragments between the rock walls.
story: The canyon repeats a sound, but never quite the way it arrived.

description: A textured patch of lichen clings to sheltered rock.
story: Life can make a home in the smallest interruption of bare stone.

description: The outline of a shell is preserved in sedimentary rock.
story: Long before these cliffs, this ground was part of another world.

description: Fresh fragments collect below a weathered cliff.
story: Even the mountains are moving, though they seem perfectly still.

description: A small patch of green marks moisture near the rock wall.
story: Where water lingers, an entire neighborhood of life can gather.
